description: This file is an HTML document used as a configuration or dialog interface within the TinyMCE rich text editor plugin 'advlink'. It contains form elements, scripts, and styling references to facilitate inserting and configuring links with advanced options in the editor.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initialization function called when the popup loads, executes scripts on load.

methods.name: insertAction
methods.description: Handles form submission to insert or update a link with the specified parameters.

methods.name: setPopupControlsDisabled
methods.description: Enables or disables popup configuration controls based on whether the 'ispopup' checkbox is checked.

methods.name: buildOnClick
methods.description: Constructs the JavaScript for the link's onclick attribute based on current form inputs.

methods.name: changeClass
methods.description: Updates the class list selection based on the input field.
